Metadata.title: Hen Kimheang — Full-Stack Developer
Metadata.description: I build websites, REST APIs and iOS & Android apps, from PHP and MySQL to Vue.js, React Native and TypeScript.

Hero.introHeading: I build websites, REST APIs and iOS & Android apps
Hero.introText: From database-driven PHP and MySQL sites to Vue.js front ends and cross-platform apps in React Native, Expo and TypeScript.
Hero.statement: Full-Stack Developer with hands-on experience across web, back-end and mobile. Right now I'm building the customer and driver apps for BS Express, a parcel delivery company in Cambodia.

paragraphs: I'm a Full-Stack Developer from Phnom Penh with hands-on experience across web, back-end and mobile: database-driven websites in PHP and MySQL, RESTful APIs connected to Vue.js front ends, and cross-platform iOS and Android apps built with React Native, Expo and TypeScript.

As a Mobile Developer at BS Express, I build the BS One and BS Driver apps on top of the company's NestJS REST API, part of a wider platform covering branch-to-branch transport, proof of delivery, returns and cash-on-delivery.
I studied Computer Science at the Royal University of Phnom Penh, and I'm keen to keep growing as an engineer across the full stack.

bsExpress.title: Mobile Developer
highlights: BS One (iOS & Android): customer app for booking and tracking parcel deliveries and booking bus tickets.
BS Driver (iOS & Android): the app drivers use every day to collect parcels, create shipments between branches and deliver parcels to customers.

Connect both apps to the BS Express NestJS back end through REST APIs, as part of a platform covering manifests and bags, proof of delivery, returns, cash-on-delivery and driver commission settlements.

fastOne.title: IT Support Specialist
highlights: Provided day-to-day desktop support, diagnosing and fixing hardware, software, network and operating system issues for staff.
Installed and configured printers, network devices and business software, and set up computers for new users.
Handled system updates, backups and antivirus management, and documented recurring issues in an internal knowledge base.

camlube.title: Web Developer
highlights: Built a dynamic, database-driven website for showcasing and selling the company's products.
Developed product listing and detail pages organized by category, with content loaded from a MySQL database.
Created back-end features in PHP so staff could add, update and remove products without editing code.

rupp.title: Computer Science
rupp.description: Plus Udemy courses in front-end (HTML5, CSS, Bootstrap, Tailwind, JavaScript, jQuery) and back-end (PHP, MySQL) web development.

camlube.title: Camlube Product Website
